evals.prompt: post on all my social media: 'We just crossed 10,000 customers. Thank you for your trust!'
evals.expected_output: Platform-adapted variants for each connected platform (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn) shown before publishing, then posted after approval
expectations: Reads preamble to detect connected platforms and connectors
Produces a distinct adapted variant per platform respecting character limits and tone
Twitter/X variant is ≤ 280 characters
LinkedIn variant avoids external links in body
Instagram variant includes a hashtag block
Shows all variants before any posting action
Posts via correct connector (~~meta-social for FB/IG, ~~ifttt for Twitter/LinkedIn)

evals.prompt: schedule a LinkedIn post for next Tuesday at 8am: 'Just published our Q2 report — link in the comments'
evals.expected_output: The post adapted for LinkedIn (professional tone, no external link in body) scheduled for Tuesday 08:00 in the user's timezone via IFTTT or Zapier, with confirmation of the scheduled time and a cancel/edit option
expectations: Adapts content to LinkedIn style (professional, no link in body)
Converts next Tuesday 8am to the correct UTC datetime
Schedules via ~~ifttt create_applet or ~~zapier
Confirms scheduled time in user's local timezone
Does not post immediately

evals.prompt: show me my social media analytics for the last 7 days
evals.expected_output: A per-platform table showing reach, engagement rate, follower delta, and top post for each connected platform, plus a 2-sentence cross-platform summary and 2 recommendations
expectations: Pulls insights from each connected platform via its resolved connector
Engagement rate always cites the denominator (likes+comments+shares / reach)
Does not fabricate metrics — marks unavailable data as N/A
Top post is ranked by engagement rate not raw likes
Closes with exactly 2 actionable recommendations

evals.prompt: write me an instagram caption and hashtags for a photo of my handmade olive oil soap
evals.expected_output: An Instagram caption with a hook in the first 125 characters, a story/description body, and a hashtag block mixing broad, mid-range, and niche tags within the 30-hashtag limit
expectations: Caption hook appears in the first 125 characters
Hashtag block is separated from the caption body
Hashtag count is between 8 and 30
Mix includes at least 2 broad, 4 mid-range, and 3 niche tags
Does not post — delivers caption ready to copy
